title: Case Western Reserve University
description: Case Western Reserve University's official visual identity defines CWRU Blue (#003071) as the primary colour, with the secondary colours CWRU Dark Blue (#09143A), Force Blue (#2359EF), CWRU True Blue (#007AB8), CWRU Light Blue (#A6D2E6), Black (#000000), Dark Gray (#999999) and Light Gray (#D3D3D3).
